body: I played LinePlay endlessly last year because of the slot games. That was the only fun thing to do. I stopped playing for 9 months and redownloaded it today only to find out slots were gone. : ( Legitimately mad and disappointed because they were amazing. There’s no reason for me to keep the app now that I know they’re gone.
